disagreement_analysis: The Qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit .gitignore and headlamp.desktop, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The Deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly determined the package is safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit .gitignore and headlamp.desktop due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing incomplete audits and inconclusive verdicts.
